brief.headline: Close the 13.6% price gap to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG and offer to commit higher volume in exchange — they're growing fast (42.6%/yr) and want the orders.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match Sayaji Industries' ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose Anhydrous IP.
priceAsk.target: ₹66.48/KG (a 13.6% cut from our current ₹75.51/KG), saving us ₹14.26 L per year
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji for the same material. The open market asks ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48 sits in the normal range. Their fast growth (42.6%/yr) shows they want volume — offer a multi-year commitment in return for matching our best price.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no reason to change it.

brief.financialLeverage: They're financially solid — ₹556.14 Cr in sales, they keep ₹3.50 of every ₹100 they sell, and they return 17.6% on the money they've put into the business. But we're tiny to them: our ₹59.65 L spend is just 0.11% of their revenue, so we have almost no individual pull. Their sales are climbing fast (42.6%/yr), which means they're hungry for orders. Use that: bundle more volume or a longer contract to justify the price cut, and keep Sayaji and two other dextrose makers (Gulshan, Sanstar) ready as alternates so they know we can walk.

evidence.point: We pay ₹75.51/KG; Sayaji charges us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
evidence.figure: 13.6% gap, costing us ₹14.26 L per year

evidence.point: Open-market asking prices for Dextrose Anhydrous IP run ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg)
We're a tiny customer to them

evidence.figure: 3.5% of sales, and return 17.6% on capital

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, B (62/100) health — a proven drop-in alternate for dextrose.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (₹842.97 Cr revenue, C health) growing capacity in starch and dextrose.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Indore-based wet-miller making Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade, exact form match); ₹365.39 Cr revenue — confirm IP monograph CoA before switching.

risks: We're only 0.11% of their business, so on our own we have almost no leverage — bundle volume, commit longer, or play them against Sayaji and the other alternates to get traction.
Their health score is B (62/100) and debt is moderate (0.41x equity) — they're stable, so don't expect desperation pricing; the ask must be tied to volume or a contract.

Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG is our anchor, but if Universal won't move and we haven't qualified the alternates (Gulshan, Sanstar, Tirupati), we may be stuck — line up at least one backup source before the meeting.
The market ask (₹60–81/kg) is wide — if they push back, they'll point to the top of that band; counter with the typical range (₹66–73/kg) and our Sayaji price.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to grow our Dextrose volume with you, but right now we're paying ₹75.51 while Sayaji gives us ₹66.48 for the same material — can you match that price if we commit to a longer contract?
